summary: Ares Acquisition Corp III filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its IPO of 39,500,000 units at $10.00 each, including 5,000,000 units from the underwriters' partial over-allotment exercise. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-tenth of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Gross proceeds were $395M. Concurrently, the sponsor purchased 7,466,667 private placement warrants at $1.50 each, generating $11.2M. Net proceeds of $395M were placed in trust for public shareholders. The SPAC will seek a business combination within the required timeframe. Watch for the target announcement and shareholder vote.
